contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (5,600.00, cents written as a raised '00') on the p2 Summary Page, which is also the figure printed on BOTH Schedule A sheets' 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages) $5600', and is re-stated at summary lines 4 and 5
contributions.detail: Both Schedule A sheets close on their OWN printed page subtotal to the cent. p3 ('Page 2 of 5'): seventeen rows sum to 200 + 500 + 50 + 50 + 200 + 500 + 500 + 250 + 500 + 500 + 500 + 300 + 250 + 200 + 150 + 250 + 500 = 5,400.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $5400'. p4 ('Page 3 of 5'): a single row of 200.00 = its printed '$200'. 5,400 + 200 = 5,600.00 EXACTLY = the schedule's own printed Total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 5,600.00 (line 3 Balance at Beginning is a SLASHED ZERO, read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling, so this is the cycle's first report) and is NOT summed as an increment. The p2 ladder closes: 0 + 5,600.00 = 5,600.00; 5,600.00 - 5,565.54 = 34.46 = line 7. No row on either sheet is in-kind and no in-kind column is printed anywhere.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (5,565.54) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also the figure printed on BOTH Schedule B sheets' 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages) $5565.54', and is re-stated at summary line 6; and, per sheet, the two printed 'Subtotal for this page' figures 4,890.02 (p5) and 675.52 (p6)
expenditures.detail: TRACED TO ONE SHEET'S OWN SUBTOTAL, and NOTHING NUDGED. The 24 rows sum to 5,565.56, which is +0.02 against the anchor 5,565.54. The delta is located exactly: p6 ('Page 5 of 5') closes to the cent — its seven rows sum to 13.88 + 7.81 + 206.09 + 17.15 + 50.00 + 305.59 + 75.00 = 675.52 = its printed subtotal — while p5 ('Page 4 of 5') does not: its seventeen rows sum to 4,890.04 against its own printed 'Subtotal for this page $4890.02'. THE FILER'S ADDITION IS THE OUTLIER, NOT THE READING. Every one of p5's seventeen amounts was escalated in a ~900 dpi strip of the amount column and every digit is unambiguous (760.19 · 918.00 · 13.85 · 74.76 · 14.71 · 5.58 · 384.66 · 25.64 · 875.00 · 193.40 · 509.84 · 8.54 · 111.50 · 209.07 · 9.79 · 9.63 · 765.88), and the subtotal cell itself was escalated to 1400 dpi and reads '$ 4890.02' with no over-writing. So no cell can absorb the 0.02 and none was altered (§C5). The 0.02 propagates upward untouched: the filer's own Total (4,890.02 + 675.52 = 5,565.54) and the cover's Column A carry it, and the p2 ladder closes on its own terms at 34.46. CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN, within the document: the other THREE schedule sheets on this filing (both Schedule A pages and the second Schedule B page) each close to the cent, so this is a one-off addition slip on one sheet, not a habit. The filer's other 2014 reports are outside this chunk and were not opened; the attribution above does not depend on them.

in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither schedule prints an in-kind column, no row is annotated in-kind anywhere on the filing, and no separate in-kind line appears on the cover. Two further 1400 dpi crops confirmed the printed Total 5,565.54 on both Schedule B sheets. notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'JEFFERY DEAN SMITH' (written in block capitals, and identically on the Report Verification line), party 'REP', Office Seeking 'Ut. COUNTY RECORDER', residence Orem UT — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it, and it agrees with the channel's office label. legacy_colAB variant, 6 pages: p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election' ticked with an X, signed 6/11/14), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed header), pp3-4 SCHEDULE A, pp5-6 SCHEDULE B. FOLIATION EXCLUDES THE COVER HERE: the summary is 'Page 1 of 5' and the schedules run 2, 3, 4, 5 'of 5', so five foliated sheets plus an unnumbered cover = the six pages `pdfinfo` reports — the document is complete as filed. That is the THIRD distinct foliation practice in this one chunk and cycle (the Buhman original excludes its cover, the Buhman amendment and the Atkin filing include it, and Lee's 'of 8' runs a sheet short) — page ordinals locate nothing. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither Yes nor No is marked, an honest BLANK that is never read as 'No' (§A4). Summary line 3 'Balance at Beginning' is a SLASHED ZERO (Ø), read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling with the glyph named here. THE FILER USED A WHOLE SCHEDULE A SHEET FOR ONE ROW (p4 carries a single 200.00 entry and its own 200.00 subtotal). A +0.02 FILER ARITHMETIC DELTA sits on the p5 subtotal and is traced in recon.expenditures; it is retained verbatim and nothing was nudged. NOT REDACTED BY THE COUNTY: this is not a *_Redacted.pdf and carries no bars — the candidate's street address and phone are visible on the cover and donor street addresses on Schedule A. None is carried here. Every Schedule A address prints a street, a city and a zip but NO STATE (§E4 cause 5), while every Schedule B address prints city, state and zip and no street at all — the same filer, two different address conventions on the two schedules of one filing. Cents are written as a RAISED pair on the whole-dollar figures and in ordinary decimal form elsewhere, sometimes on the same page.
